newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SOUNESS MUST WAIT ON F.A. DECISION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SOUNESS MUST WAIT ON F.A. DECISION.

text.p: Southampton manager Graeme Souness will have to wait to find out if he will be back in the Football Association "dock" after a verbal outburst against referee Graham Poll.
Souness angrily confronted the official after his side's 3-1 F.A. Cup defeat at first division Reading on Saturday.
A cordon of Reading stewards separated the Southampton boss from Poll with Souness subsequently giving full vent to his anger over the game having gone ahead on the rock-hard pitch.
Souness denied he had said anything to the official
during the confrontation, adding he was only attempting to extricate Israeli midfielder Eyal Berkovic from a situation which might had landed the player in trouble.
F.A. spokesman Steve Double said on Sunday: "We'll have to wait and see Graham Poll's report before we can decide if further action is necessary."
Double added: "Managers should be aware through the League Managers' Association that the F.A. believes there is a need for a cooling-off period after games before they should approach referees."
Sounes was fined by the F.A.earlier this season for comments made to the referee after a game at Leicester
